messages:
Emma: FYI, customer 'AcmePay' flagged unexpected extra token usage on invoice INV-2026-03. They say spikes line up with a few 504s earlier that day. Can someone dig?
Raj: Can you paste the request_id(s) and a sample timestamp?
Emma: request_id=01G8X0FQ6ZJ2M4K9, 01G8X1H7A3K9P2L0. First seen at 2026-03-14T09:12:05Z. Customer says client retried after timeouts.
Emma: Also their app doesn't set an Idempotency-Key header currently.
Raj: OK that's suspicious. If client retried without idempotency semantics ingress could have replayed the request and billed twice. I'll check gateway logs.
billing-bot: [metering-alert] Customer invoice spike detected for acct=acmepay, delta=+42% vs rolling baseline. Triggered rule: ‘‘retry-pattern-delta’’. 
Raj: Found both request IDs in the ingress proxy access logs. I see two upstream completions for the same user payload fingerprint around 09:12:05 and 09:12:07. Logs: ```[09:12:05Z] proxy req_id=01G8X0FQ6ZJ2M4K9 upstream=lm-1 status=504; [09:12:07Z] proxy req_id=01G8X0FQ6ZJ2M4K9 upstream=lm-2 status=200```. Means gateway retried to another backend after timeout and both completed; our metering recorded both.
Jen: Do we dedupe at the metering layer by request_id or idempotency-key?
Raj: Metering currently keys on completion events and uses request_id (generated per ingress attempt) not client-supplied idempotency-key. Gateway retry generates a new request_id when it re-issues. So duplicate billing is possible if first attempt eventually succeeds or our retry logic triggers billing twice.
Liz: That's the billing impact. If upstream returned 504 then retried and succeeded, ledger saw two consumption events. We should validate with token-usage table: run `select * from token_usage where acct='acmepay' and invoice='INV-2026-03' and time>='2026-03-14T09:00:00Z'` and look at the `orig_request_hash` column.
Emma: I ran a search: two meter entries reference the same payload hash but different request_id. Hash: d4c3b2a1. Both show ~150 tokens each.
Raj: Repro steps I used to validate locally: 1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d @prompt.json 2) Simulate 504 by dropping response on first backend 3) Client retries with same body and no Idempotency-Key -> gateway issues a new attempt -> both attempts complete.
Raj: Minimal repro curl to show behavior: ```for i in 1 2; do curl -s -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://local-proxy:8080/v1/generate; sleep 1; done```
Jen: Thanks. Short term mitigations? Can we patch metering to dedupe by `payload_hash` + `acct` within a short window (say 30s) so we don't double-count transient retries?
Liz: We can issue a credit for the duplicated tokens for this invoice once we validate the two entries match on payload_hash and timestamp proximity. I'll prepare a credit queue item.
Raj: I'll open an eng-plat ticket to: 1) make gateway propagate client-supplied `Idempotency-Key` and 2) have ingress attach idempotency-key to downstream requests and to the metering event, and 3) add dedupe window at metering using (acct, payload_hash) as fallback.
Emma: Please post the ticket link here. Customer wants ETA for credit and a mitigation timeline.
Liz: Credit queued, pending Raj's verification and a quick audit. ETA for customer credit: 48 hrs.
Raj: Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4521 - will prioritize as P1. Plan: quick dedupe rule (hotfix) + longer term idempotency propagation.
Emma: Can someone add a note to the console alerts so support sees the potential dup billing flag when 5xx -> success patterns occur? :eyes:
Jen: Good idea. Adding a lightweight signal in Console: correlate ingress 5xx followed by 2xx within 30s as a 'possible-replay' flag. I'll scope work.
Liz: I'll hold on issuing the final credit until the audit is done.
Emma: Thanks team. I'll reply to AcmePay with an interim update: we found replay evidence, credit pending audit, escalation ticket INF-4521.
Raj: FYI we should also log the upstream node that succeeded so if a backend bug caused delayed success we can correlate.
Emma: noted. Closing loop once INF-4521 has a PR. :+1:
